relationship_coverage.description: Bounded direct links within this originating case. Absent or unknown means collection is unknown; incomplete means some support or endpoints are unavailable. No multi-hop completeness, causal magnitude or portfolio weights are claimed.

truncated.description: True when the requested edge-step budget prevents completing traversal within the requested depth.

available_at.description: Availability of the returned case and endpoint support at the requested cutoff.

citation_ids.description: Originating source Evidence supporting this relationship statement.

derivation.description: source_explicit is directly stated; source_implied follows the source argument; engine_inferred is BeliefState's inference and must never become the author's view.

identity_citation_ids.description: Endpoint identity support; these citations do not independently establish the relationship statement.

derivation.description: The sequence is BeliefState's composition, never a source-authored causal conclusion. Individual edge derivation remains unchanged.

edge_indexes.description: Ordered indexes into this investment_case.relationships list. Every intermediate edge remains present with its separate source/identity citations and derivation.

full_document_stored.description: Recorded storage flag, separate from verified source completeness. Null or absent means unknown.

source_text_coverage.description: Stored source-capture scope. Null or absent means unknown; no value here verifies complete article coverage.

anyOf.description: Stored claim qualifications, including source attribution, forecast and comparison periods, assumptions, limitations, definitions, prior state and causal context. These qualify the claim; they are not independently verified facts. Null or omitted means unavailable, not unconditional.

assessment.description: Qualification at this read cutoff, separate from the unchanged recorded status. Provider capability describes supported inputs, not enabled monitoring. A current check does not validate the whole investment case.
